adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows a sustained offset starting near index 490 (jump to ~7–8 mm in N, ~10–12 mm in E, ~8–10 mm in U) and persisting through index 542–545, followed by a clear return to pre-offset levels by index 546–547 (values drop back to ~-1 to -3 mm N, ~-0.5 to -2 mm E, ~0–2 mm U). The interior (490–545) is stable with small scatter, supporting a genuine temporary platform. P1 (490–542) ends just before the return begins; P2 (490–545) better captures the full platform including the last stable offset point before return at 546. No independent permanent step is evident within the interval. Thus, P2 is the correct platform; P1 is suboptimal and overlapping.
